Implementation of HAVANA Act of 2021 — This rule provides implementation by the Department of Homeland Security ("the Department" or "DHS") of the HAVANA Act of 2021. The HAVANA Act provides authority for agency heads to provide payments to certain individuals who have incurred qualifying injuries to the brain. This rule covers current and former Department of Homeland Security employees and their dependents.
